SELECTED_INDEX: 5
CONFIDENCE: 0.72
EXPLANATION: The strong, narrow band at 2247 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of a nitrile C≡N stretch, and the features at ~918 and ~1108 cm⁻¹ are consistent with C–O–C ring/ether modes expected for a cyclic ether. The cluster of CH stretches at 2997/2933/2887 cm⁻¹ and CH bending near 1462 cm⁻¹ further support an aliphatic, oxygenated nitrile. Candidate 5 (CC1C(C#N)OC1(C)C) uniquely matches the nitrile plus cyclic ether pattern among the higher-ranked options. Supporting rule: GFQ-003 (C–H stretching, nakamoto2008infrared).
